title: MovementCommitted v1
description: Emitted by farm-edge (owner: Dong A) after a gate passage is committed locally, through the transactional outbox. Consumer: movement-alert (central projection). The farm-edge store is the source of truth for the farm count; central is a projection. eventId is stable across retries, so consumers dedupe on it. edgeSeq is gapless and monotonic per farm, so a consumer can detect missing events (gaps) and stale or out-of-order ones.

presenceAfter.description: Tag presence at the edge after this passage.

anomaly.description: True when the direction contradicts the known presence (e.g. IN while already INSIDE). Recorded and needs review; never silently dropped.

occurredAt.description: Reader source time of the first observation of the passage.
